bio: As its sign suggests, Osteria Aboo in Jeonpo-dong oddly labels itself a Western gastropub. Since 2017, this establishment has strived to offer authentic Southern Italian cuisine, a cuisine characterized by ample use of seafood-based ingredients. Among all the exquisite items on the menu, we are partial to the bisque pasta, featuring al dente noodles and a sumptuous amount of fresh and savory red-banded lobster, as well as the newly added Mare (“sea”) course. When paired with a chef-recommended wine, the cuisine will astonish you with the rich flavors of Italy....
